_comment: Button indices use the standard Xbox controller layout. Axis values range from -1 to 1.

buttons._comment: A adds, B removes, X changes type, Y toggles layers, LB/RB select layers, Back toggles spin, Start toggles the panel.
buttons._dpadComment: D-pad: Up/Down select layers; Left/Right adjust speed.

axes._comment: Left stick horizontal changes number of elements.
Left stick vertical selects the previous or next layer.
